name: tenants_set_planning_rule
description: Set the active tenant's default for one Team Planning rule, by its name from tenants_planning_rules. value is an object in the shape that rule's value_schema gives. Every plan follows it until the plan sets the rule itself. A refusal names what is wrong, never the value. Returns the rule as tenants_planning_rules lists it. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
